name: The Cursed Sword (pre-pre-pre-pre-pre-pre-Alpha)
author: fogodo
description:
You are a cursed gunsword that has to tag along with whatever hero buys you! Fight enemies until your hero dies, but the game isn't over, you as the sword just get more infamous, and you keep attracting stronger and stronger heros that will go farther and farther!

At least that's the idea. Ran into time constraint issues, and what you see is what you get!

Thank you to my girlfriend for the Gunsword art! (and a bunch more that I wasn't able to implement yet)
